title: Understanding Failure Patterns in LLM-Based Mathematical Optimization Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.33351v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Industrial optimization involves complex constraints, making optimization modeling difficult to automate. Large language models (LLMs) have been explored for generating optimization models from natural language, but their reliability in end-to-end settings remains limited, often producing non-executable, infeasible, or feasible but incorrect solutions. In this work, we study failure modes in LLM-based optimization modeling by decomposing the process into three components: mathematical reasoning, solver usage, and domain knowledge, and constructing datasets that target each aspect. Using these datasets, we analyze how different components relate to errors and find that they are associated with different types of failure, although these relationships are not always strong or consistent. Furthermore, while combining these components improves execution reliability, feasible but incorrect solutions remain the dominant failure mode, suggesting

translated_title: 理解基于大语言模型的数学优化建模中的失败模式
translated_abstract: 工业优化涉及复杂的约束条件，使得优化建模难以自动化。大语言模型（LLM）已被探索用于从自然语言生成优化模型，但它们在端到端场景中的可靠性仍然有限，经常产生不可执行的、不可行的或可行但不正确的解。在这项工作中，我们通过将基于LLM的优化建模过程分解为三个组成部分——数学推理、求解器使用和领域知识——并构建针对各方面的数据集，来研究其失败模式。利用这些数据集，我们分析了不同组成部分与错误之间的关系，发现它们与不同类型的失败相关联，尽管这些关系并不总是很强或一致。此外，虽然组合这些组成部分可以提高执行可靠性，但可行但不正确的解仍然是主导的失败模式，这表明……
tldr: 该研究将LLM优化建模过程分解为数学推理、求解器使用和领域知识三个组成部分，通过构建针对性数据集分析失败模式，发现即便组合这些能力，可行但不正确的解仍是主要的失败类型。
en_tdlr: This work decomposes LLM-based optimization modeling into mathematical reasoning, solver usage, and domain knowledge components, builds targeted datasets to analyze failure modes, and finds that feasible but incorrect solutions remain the dominant failure mode even when combining these components.
